provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: slice-and-lift: the single rank-4 decomposition of |H3>^3 up to symmetry does not extend to |H3>^4

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop, four workers at low priority under a load average near 12: 1183 s for the enumeration and lift

notes: chi(H3^3) = 4 exactly (Lean witness and rank-3 exclusion). A rank-4 decomposition of |H3>^4 sliced along one qutrit gives a rank-4 decomposition of |H3>^3 whose terms are related slice to slice by a Pauli and cube roots of unity. |H3>^3 has one rank-4 decomposition up to its unitary symmetries (group of order 384, 170 pivot orbits) and no Pauli assignment satisfies the other two slices. Supersedes the rank-2 exclusion at m=4 (chi >= 3). The enumeration runs in the compiled pivot-pair kernel with the stabilizer reductions; it is over the default budget because the symmetry group is small, so the certificate declares 3600 s. Puts the cell at 5 <= chi <= 8.
